propositions: Each of three xdist workers under '-n 3 --dist worksteal' independently fills the process-local lru_cache on _rendered(), causing 178 corpus bodies to be re-rendered three times instead of once, burning ~56s of additional CPU per session.
The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests each recompute pass-1 renders that _rendered() already cached, duplicating ~12s of work per test.

A session-scoped cross-worker artifact protected by os.mkdir-based mutual exclusion with a 150s fallback deadline allows all workers to share a single corpus render per session while remaining session-hermetic and timing-safe.

The artifact filename embeds a SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON files, wiki_render module source, and pandoc executable metadata, so corpus or renderer edits invalidate cached renders and force fresh computation.

Sharding the artifact per stratum (code_arrow/table/prose) with PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated probe order allows cold sessions to complete one stratum's wall time instead of the whole corpus by filling different shards concurrently.
